limits: No live API/source freshness, external provider, Git or storefront action was performed. Root alone releases after fresh source and before-value guards.
Truncated English titles retain ellipses. Clear role/color/garment expansions were considered against bound source body; no approval of unknown missing suffixes is implied.

English garment slogans and Dress Like Mommy/DLM remain intentional. Source style/collection identifiers such as Chic Family Tides, Dynamic Duo, Scarlet, Sunshine Stripe, Red Heart Raglan, Red Resort, Golden Daisy, Sunshine Daisy, Bird Chirping and Good Night Song of the Sea remain source identifiers, not a claim that they are registered brands. Other descriptive prose is localized.

Ordinary source material, sizing and occasion claims are reviewed for translation fidelity, not independently verified supplier truth. Existing held source/body contradictions are not released by this review.
